g.text: System residue keeps a system seal outside its deployment (DR-101)
the send matches a genesis contract
(seal has only Unit regions: system body)
run the body in residue mode
store the node with the residue seal
a COMM of deployment A consumes the node
a COMM consumes the node that deployment A stored
stays a Unit region with no demand
obligations only in the regions of B
feasible assignment from the sources of B
debit the purse of B only;
The COMM of B then had demand in the
lane of A, which no source of B can fund:
A process held in a variable (EVar) or produced by
a method (EMethod) runs outside residue mode
(P1 rem:signed-subst). It is the caller's code,
Genesis and system deploys run with the Unit payer,
shared system state written by system bodies
